subject: STABLE texture-opus #4: YCbCr IOSurface textures (CA app-launch '420v' snapshots, format 500 + 502-545) as exact decode shadows
body: Reference (ansuz CA-METAL 10.3): CA's launch zoom samples the app snapshot = '420v' 2-plane IOSurface made a texture of format 500; it is refused today. Now: sampled-only textures of 500/502/503/505-510 (converted), 520-530 (_sRGB), 540-542 (codes, RGBA8) over 420v/420f/422v/422f/444v/444f/x420/xf20/x422/xf22/x444/xf44/p420..pf44 get an owned decode shadow (RGBA16F; RGBA8 for 8-bit codes; 543-545 10-bit codes refuse until 90 is bindable) re-decoded on each IOSurface seed change. Decode = Metal's measured integer model as documented by the pinned translator (bind/ycbcr_convert.rs): 9/3/3/1 chroma (3/1 for 4:2:2), video/full range from the OSType, matrix from kIOSurfaceYCbCrMatrix via IOSurfaceCopyValue (none/601->BT.601, 709 and SMPTE_240M->BT.709, 2020; other values refuse), sRGB twins via the 513 generated knots (formula reproduces the translator table exactly; half rounding ties-away), converted values exact in half. NEW gpu/metal/tegu/ycbcr_decode.h 5629b322 (pure C, builtins only), NEW gpu/tests/ycbcr_decode_test.py 1f919296 (independent Python reference: 144 random surfaces, 4204 texels bit-exact, all formats/ranges/matrices/odd sizes/packed; BT.601/709 float anchors). xr_decode_table.h 009b48fb (+tegu_srgb_knots_8192) from tools/gen_xr_decode_table.py e5f03cbb; render_encoder.inc 15ed2db8; compositor_submit.inc 7cde94ea (tegu_shadow_copy YCbCr branch only); tests/texture_format_frontend_test.py 3ddb67d0 (YCBCR_IMPORTS ok=3 + 420v draw status4). Refusals are explicit TEGU_IOSURFACE_REFUSED reasons ycbcr-matrix/-surface-format/-plane/-plane-shape. CPU cost: one decode per snapshot change (~2.7M texels for 1125x2436; not yet measured on device; a GPU conversion pass is the follow-up if it shows). Gates: frontend objects ARM64 PASS (after removing a <string.h> include that broke the iOS build), render harness PASS, CA test PASS 41, iosurface_cpu PASS, texture_format_frontend_test PASS, integration: render cache/variant threads/producer/candidate OK; FAILS NOT MINE: 'inert render pass' (integration_tests/inert_render_pass_test.m fake TeguRenderEncoder lacks perfRawLoad/perfRawStore that encode's uncommitted nord2_render_pass.inc:175 now writes -> test owner please add the ivars) + known CoreAnimation 66/42. Snapshot gpu/build/texture-coverage-20261026/p4-ycbcr-stable. Next: XR render-target IOSurface (c6l 2x fmt=554 usage 5), then P2 widening/profile.
